description: Where is ship <imo/mmsi> — live AIS position + destination for a single vessel. Locate a ship by its IMO number, MMSI, or Datalastic UUID; returns current lat/lon, speed, course, heading, destination and navigation status. Example: datalastic_vessel({ imo: "9302947", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Datalastic API key (get one with a trial at datalastic.com)

imo.description: Vessel IMO number, e.g. "9302947" (provide at least one of imo/mmsi/uuid)

mmsi.description: Vessel MMSI number, e.g. "477995900" (provide at least one of imo/mmsi/uuid)

uuid.description: Datalastic vessel UUID (provide at least one of imo/mmsi/uuid)

name: datalastic_vessel
title: Datalastic Vessel
